# Good Guys Pools

> Good Guys Pools is a New Jersey in-ground swimming pool contractor based in Hackensack (Bergen County). We design and build new in-ground pools, renovate and resurface existing pools, and repair leaks, equipment and structure for homeowners within about 50 miles of Hackensack — New Jersey only.

- Phone: (201) 822-1189
- Address: 86-110 Orchard Street, Hackensack, NJ 07601
- NJ Home Improvement Contractor registration: 13VH14082500
- Service area: Bergen, Passaic, Morris, Essex, Hudson, Union, Somerset, Sussex, and parts of Middlesex, Monmouth, Hunterdon, Warren and Mercer counties (NJ). We do not work in New York.
